title: Nine Rows of Teaching
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（生活与学习·学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（生活与学习·学校生活）　|　核心词汇：class　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 class 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 my mother was sent to teach ① class she could not quiet, and she said the teaching was the whole of the lesson. The ② class, meaning the pupils and not the lesson, was nine rows deep and was taught by whoever came last; class, she said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ class in that school had the same window, and the ④ class at the end, meaning the one the headmaster kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever taught properly. Class, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ class was the whole of the system, meaning the rank it carried and not the pupils. The ⑥ class, meaning the rank and not any of that, is the only thing in a system that everybody knows and nobody questions; class, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both pupils and a rank. She said the rank is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ class had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the window. The ⑧ class of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine rows and eleven years of teaching; class, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ class I remember is the one at the end, which was taught in 1965 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ class, my grandmother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being taught; every class, she said, is a rank that has agreed to look like pupils. She said the rank was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 班级（指那些学生本身，与那节课相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach a class 教一个班
D. n. 班级（指那所学校里每一个）
E. n. 班级（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 阶级；等级（抽象：它承载的那个阶层）
G. n. 那个阶层（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The class, meaning the pupils and not the lesson
class was the whole of the system
the class had become a number in a report
The class of the whole thing
A class, my grandmother said in 1970

answers.why: teach a class 意为“教一个班”，1945 年母亲被派去教她管不住安静的那个班。
class 意为“班、班级”，指那些学生本身而不是那节课，共九排，由最后来的人教。
class 指那所学校里每一个班，每一个班都是同样的窗子。
class 指末尾那一个班（校长保留的那一个），是唯一有人认真教过的。
class 意为“阶级、等级”，抽象指它承载的那个阶层，父亲说 class 就是那套制度的全部。
class 为抽象用法，指那个阶层本身，是一套制度里人人都知道、却没人质疑的东西。
class 意为“班、班级”，到 1960 年这个 class 成了报告里的一个数字。
class 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九排座位和十一年的教学。
class 意为“班级”，我记得的是末尾那一个班，1965 年教过，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
class 为抽象总称，祖母说一个班级是唯一会因为被认真教学而变好的东西。
